links.why: The participle clause 'one who works a palm of slackness' is a relative clause inside the subject noun phrase of the predicate 'poor'. It is not a bare participle after a finite clause, so 'describing' does not apply. The nesting stands.
links.category: participle nested in subject noun phrase

links.why: Plain waw setting the diligent hand against the slack one: contrast by sense, not cause, result or purpose. The 'and' link stands.
